subject: Request: One-off POC extension + discretionary credits for AlderBio evaluation
messages:
From: Claire Ng <claire.ng@alderbio.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: AlderBio sandbox — ask for another 60 days + credits

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the intro call earlier. AlderBio's genomics team has been running larger batches than we planned — model fine-tuning and long-context retrospectives have burned through our sandbox allotment faster than expected. We're about to hit the quota and the evaluation will be incomplete if we stop now.

Can Redwood extend the sandbox for another 60 days and provide an additional pool of credits we can use just for running the analytics jobs? We understand this is outside the standard PLG sandbox policy; happy to document the outcomes and do a short case study if the POC reaches the success criteria.

Claire Ng
Director, Applied AI — AlderBio
claire.ng@alderbio.com

Attachment: POC-usage-snapshot-20270719.csv (csv, 42KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: AlderBio sandbox — ask for another 60 days + credits

Marissa / Aditya — forwarding AlderBio's request. Key points:
- They're mid-run on long-context genomics evaluations; current run will stop at quota.
- Ask: 60-day sandbox extension + discretionary credits to cover heavy batch runs (they suggested a non-specific uplift).
- Regulated environment; they asked about data retention and an audit snapshot. They've included a usage CSV.

My recommended concession (based on the account health and ARR potential):
- One-off 60-day extension (no contract change)
- $75,000 in promotional credits allocated to their sandbox project, expires after the extension
- Limited addendum: Redwood will provide a single compliance snapshot (compliance-summary.pdf) and agree to keep POC data for 90 days after the sandbox extension ends

This deviates from standard PLG limits on credit grants — hence the ask for exec sign-off. They are an early-stage strategic biotech (AlderBio) with an expected mid-market deal if the POC proves out.

Questions for execs: Do we approve the one-off credit pool + extension? If so, I can prepare a short addendum and Ops runbook.

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: AlderBio-MAP.xlsx (xls, 58KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: AlderBio sandbox — ask for another 60 days + credits

Ben — copied Aditya for escalations. Ben, appreciate the suggested concession and the clear success leverage. A few clarifications before I greenlight to execs:
1) Can you quantify the $75k estimate? Is that token-equivalent (in our pricing model) or a fiscal credit? We need an expected token burn breakdown.
2) Put a hard stop in the extension: no SLA change, no production entitlements. Add a clause limiting further credit asks unless specific milestones are met.
3) Procurement wants a one-page MOU that says credits are promotional and not billable. They also asked for a limited audit snapshot — keep it to one standard report.

If you can update the one-pager + expected usage numbers, I'll escalate to Aditya for approval. If Aditya signs off, this goes to CEO-level only if there's policy divergence.

Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: AlderBio sandbox — ask for another 60 days + credits

Quick decision: I'm comfortable approving this as a one-off under the conditions Marissa outlined. Approvals:
- 60-day extension: APPROVED
- Promotional credit pool: APPROVED up to $75,000 equivalent (must be registered against RDW-2027-4732 and expire at extension end)
- Deliverables: Ben to provide a 1-page MOU (promotional credits only), token-burn estimate, and the limited compliance snapshot.
- Ops: No change to SLAs; no production access. If they ask for additional credits or changes to retention beyond the agreed 90 days, reconnect with me.

Ben — please send the MOU and the token burn table today; I'll sign off and Ops can provision the credits. Also add a line that the credit grant does not alter list pricing or future billing.

Aditya Rao
VP, Revenue — Redwood Inference
